query: SELECT *                FROM public.command_principal p WHERE p.organization_id=p_organization_id AND p.principal_id=p_principal_id
principal.mercado_livre_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_mercado_livre_connection_id OR principal.omie_connection_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_omie_connection_id

NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.s2a_attestation_consumption c WHERE c.organization_id=p_organization_id AND c.manifest_id=p_manifest_id AND c.principal_id=p_principal_id AND c.manifest_digest=snapshot.result_manifest_digest AND c.correlation_id=p_correlation_id)

EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.command_permission_grant g WHERE g.organization_id=p_organization_id AND (g.grant_id=p_grant_id OR (g.principal_id=p_principal_id AND g.permission='TRANSACTION_IDENTITY_DECISION_WRITE')))
EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.command_authority_operation o WHERE o.organization_id=p_organization_id AND o.attestation_manifest_id=p_manifest_id AND o.operation='GRANT')

SELECT p.*
                                   FROM public.command_principal p
     WHERE p.organization_id=p_organization_id
       AND p.principal_id=p_principal_id
     FOR UPDATE

SELECT g.*
                               FROM public.command_permission_grant g
     WHERE g.organization_id=p_organization_id
       AND g.principal_id=p_principal_id
       AND g.permission=p_permission
     ORDER BY g.revision DESC
     LIMIT 1

NOT FOUND
       OR current_grant.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'ENABLED'
       OR current_grant.grant_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_grant_id
       OR current_grant.revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_grant_revision
